ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring tool to audit industrial compliance and carbon footprint for manufacturing hubs in the National Capital Region.
ideas.title: EcoAudit India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the proven architecture of GeoNex-ATLAS to address pressing local industrial pollution and regulatory monitoring challenges in New Delhi.

ideas.pitch: Personalized nutritional wellness platform tailored specifically to traditional Indian regional diets and local grocery availability.
ideas.title: NutriLocal AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant while targeting the hyper-localized dietary needs of judges and students in New Delhi.

ideas.pitch: Graph-intelligence based AML and fraud risk detection platform for micro-transactions in campus and local peer-to-peer delivery networks.
ideas.title: DelhiGrid RiskEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings the hardcore graph intelligence and risk-scoring depth seen in Bito into a practical local financial security use case.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous multi-agent student support and task delegation platform built with LangGraph to handle institutional queries and resource allocation.
ideas.title: CampusCred Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the multi-agent orchestration architecture of greennovation-ai-platform, highly appealing to hackathon organizers from academic institutions.

ideas.pitch: Poisson regression and GAM-based incident forecasting tool predicting urban congestion and public transit bottlenecks across New Delhi.
ideas.title: DelhiPulse Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs rigorous statistical modeling and calibrated prediction intervals proven successful in AI forecasting competitions.
